correctness.rationale: For p>=7 apply the named smoothness theorem; in p=3 the complete Vandermonde-rank and two-value case proof excludes all singularities. Adjunction yields genus four and canonical type (2,3). Its unique quadratic form has integer Hessian determinant five, so the p-rational rulings exist iff five is a square. Both canonical trigonal pencils are those rulings. The universal witness [1:0:-1:i:-i] (i²=-1) gives a rational tangent line or a Galois-stable quadratic secant; a plane pencil through that line has degree at most four. Ruling obstruction gives lower bound four in nonsplit case, and rational rulings degree three in split case. verify.py and verify_witnesses.py were run on current package paths with VERIFY_OK.
